content.short: An easy way to create, moderate, and curate financial information
content.description:
Finclout is the first social-crypto backed financial content contextualization site. We aim to build a fairer investment environment for the retail trader helping you to learn what is moving the markets right now, why, and who thinks what will happen next.

Using a no-fomo, non-engagement driven design, we are building a community that values better information. Connect with people who matter. Our engine helps match your expertise with relevant news and people for deeper insights. Get access to special events, meetings, and conversations. Coin holding requirements reduce spam for content creators. Join a financial wisdom metaverse that is faster, cheaper, and better for the environment. Hook up a supported wallet and you are ready to earn.
